UPTAC Admission 2026 Online Form - Complete Details

UPTAC Admission 2026 Online Form. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 15/06/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 19/05/2026
  • Last Date : 15/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 15/06/2026
  • Entrance Exam Date : 1st Week July 2026
  • Admit Card : As Per Schedule
  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • All Category Candidates : Rs. 1000/-

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 19/05/2026
  • Last Date : 15/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 15/06/2026

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
